exposure: breast cancer diagnosis in the first or second trimesters
cohort: 24 babies born to women diagnosed with breast cancer in the first or second trimesters, weighing >400 g and/or >20 weeks' gestation
finding: Other than induced preterm births, there were no serious adverse perinatal outcomes observed in babies exposed to chemotherapy in utero.
mod_finding: This study mentions that of the 18 infants exposed to chemotherapy in utero, 11 were born by induced labor or pre-labor cesarean section.
